book.title: Ioane Iifa Faunina Iesu Fouga Ioane Epapua Auga

content: Iesu Ega Apostolo Ifeꞌi Eikuisa

Ke kina agaꞌomo eka Pasover miamia agemia auga kinagai, Iesu iꞌina agofaꞌa agepuaꞌafuga Ama eega agelao auga kina emai ekainia auga elogo. Ke ifo ega papiau iꞌina agofaꞌagai keagu auꞌi, alo koꞌagai aniꞌi eani alogaina mo emai pau kai, pau auga isa aniꞌi eani alogaina auga fua ipauma pau epakinaꞌi.

Egaꞌina kinagai Iesu ega imoi fou gapigapi foꞌamaga keaniia. Kai egaꞌina alogai tiapolo Judas Iskariot, Saimon gauga, Iesu feꞌafaꞌafalaina auga opolaga apala alogai eogeisa efua kai, isa keagu keaniani.
Iesu isa Ama kapa maꞌoai isa ega isapu papagai epamiaꞌi eꞌimaꞌi auga elogo. Ke isa Deo eegai emai ke agemue Deo eega agelao pugu auga isafa elogo.
Ega puo anianiai eꞌuegekae afe tiapuga eiꞌiuka auga eafilaisa eoge meꞌe kai, tauele uufagai egopeisa.
Egae kai fei eafiia litiai eꞌefauka kai, eꞌina ega imoi ifeꞌi eikuisa. Ke tauele uufagai egope auga eafiia ifeꞌi epaigu fugania.
Iesu emai Saimon, Peto keoma auga ife gaikua eoma aisama, Saimon einaka, “Lopia, oi lau ifeu aloikuꞌi ma?” eoma.
Ke Iesu einaka, “Lau kapaꞌina lakapa auga pau afoloisa kai, muniai aisama aloisa alologo,” eoma.
Kai Peto einaka, “Laaꞌi, iifa gome ifeu afoloikuꞌi laaꞌi,” eoma. Ke Iesu einaka, “Oi ifemu afalaikuꞌi koa aisama, oi lau eꞌu imoi afolomia,” eoma.
Ega aisama Saimon Peto keoma auga einaka, “Lopia, ega koa aisama ifeu mo foloikuꞌi kai, imau ke kaniau isafa fou moikuꞌi,” eoma.
Kai Iesu einaka, “Papiau agaꞌo eufele efua auga ife mo feikua, gome isa faaga fofouga auga aeofu. Ke oi maꞌoai auga alomi felo kai, epomiai agaꞌo auga alo eofu,” eoma.
Gome Iesu kaisau isa ageꞌafaꞌafalaina auga elogo puo, aeifa isa maꞌoꞌiai aloꞌi felo aeoma.
Iesu isa maꞌoai ifeꞌi eikuisa efua aisama, afe tiapuga eiꞌiuka pugu kai, elao afugai eagukipo. Egae kai ega imoi epaꞌani peniꞌi einaka, “Oi faagamiai kapaꞌina lakapaisa auga ologo ma?
Oi lau oifaniau ‘Pamalele Aumu’ ke ‘Lopia’ ooma. Oi lau ega oifa oomaisau auga oifa feloisau, gome lau egaꞌina au.
Pau lau oi emi Lopia ke emi Pamalele Au oi ifemi laikuisa koa iꞌopoga, oi isafa ifomi agaꞌo agaꞌo ifemi foikua.
Ke lau laomai felo oi lapakinaimi auga oi faumiai lakapaisa koa iꞌopoga oi isafa fokapa.
Iifa gome maamiai laifania. Pinauga auga ega au akaikiꞌa ega akaikiꞌa aekaꞌegaina. Ega koa iꞌopoga, iifa ipapea auga kaisau isa eulaisa auga aekaꞌegaina.
Pau iꞌina kapaꞌi ologo ke agokapaꞌi koa aisama, Deo kapa feloꞌi agepenimi.

“Lau oi maꞌoai mo foumi alaifania, gome lau kaisau mo lakinaniꞌi auꞌi lalogoniꞌi. Kai iꞌina iifaꞌi laifaniꞌi auꞌi Deo ega iifa pukagai iifa kekae auꞌi koꞌaꞌi mo fekemia kainai: ‘Kaisau lau fou lau eꞌu palafa aania auga, lau ageumakalainiau ke ageꞌafaꞌafalainiau.’
“Lau faagauai egaꞌina kapaꞌi akemia koa kai oi maamiai laifaniꞌi, ega koa faagauai akemia aisama, lau Mesaia auga fopakoꞌania laoma.
Iifa gome maamiai laifania. Papiau kapa lau au agaꞌo laulaisa auga ageifa koko koa aisama, isa lau eifa kokoisau. Ke kaisau lau eifa kokoisau auga, lau Amau eulaisau auga eifa koko,” eoma.
Iesu egaꞌina eifania afegai, alo maikiekiegai eifa einaka, “Iifa gome maamiai laifania. Oi epomiai aufalao agaꞌo lau ageꞌafaꞌafalainiau,” eoma.
Ega aisama Iesu ega imoi Iesu kaisau eifania auga akelogo puo ifoꞌi mo maaꞌi keisa.
Isa ega imoi epoꞌiai agaꞌo Iesu anina eani alogaina auga Iesu eegai eagu eaniani.
Saimon Peto keoma auga imoi egaꞌina Iesu gapaꞌani penia kaisau eifania auga gouga ekapaisa einaka, “Kaisau eifania auga mopaꞌani penia gaifania,” eoma.
Ke isa Iesu eega elao faagagai eꞌafeau kai epaꞌani penia einaka, “Lopia kaisau oi ageꞌafaꞌafalainio?” eoma.
Ke Iesu einaka, “Palafa iꞌina alaꞌiupa au kapa alapenia auga, isa lau ageꞌafaꞌafalainiau,” eoma. Egae kai palafa eafiia auga eꞌiupia kai Saimon gauga, Judas Iskariot epeniia.
Ke Judas palafa eafiia aisama, fiakoa mo Satani isa alogai ekoko. Ega aisama Iesu isa epainia einaka, “Kapaꞌina mokapa looma auga fokapa fofiakoa,” eoma.
Kai maꞌoai egae keagu keaniani auꞌi kapa puo Iesu isa ega epaini oma auga akelogo.
Gome Judas moni eꞌimaisa kainai isaꞌi keopolaga Iesu isa epaina, kapaꞌina miamiai akepapinauga auga gaꞌafa eoma keoma, o kapa agaꞌo ulalu papiauꞌi gapeniꞌi eoma keoma.
Judas palafa eafiia aisama, fiakoa mo eꞌue epealai. Ke egaꞌina auga gapiai emia.
Iesu Peto Isa Agepuniaiaina Auga Fouga Eifania
Judas elao efua aisama, Iesu eifa einaka, “Pau Papiau Aumauni Gauga isapu akaikiꞌa eafiia, ke au akaikiꞌa emia, ke Deo isafa ega akaikiꞌa ala koa auga Papiau Aumauni Gauga faagagai eafiia efua.

Isa faagagai Deo ega isapu ke ega akaikiꞌa ala koa auga eafiia koa aisama, Deo faagagai Isa Gauga ega akaikiꞌa, ke ega isapu ala koa auga agefoki agoisa. Ke fiakoa mo Deo isa isapu agepenia, ke au akaikiꞌa agepamia.
“Eꞌu imoi aumi, lau oi fou agaagu epo afaemaefa. Ke Iudea papiauꞌi lapainiꞌi koa iꞌopoga, pau oi isafa lapainimi. Oi lau agokapuniau kai lau ala lalao auga oi ega afololao.
“Ke lau iifa kapula mamaga oi lapenimi. Oi alomi koꞌagai agaꞌo agaꞌo animi foani. Ke lau alou koꞌagai oi animi laani koa iꞌopoga, oi isafa agaꞌo agaꞌo animi ega foani oma.
Oi agaꞌo agaꞌo animi agoani aisama, oi lau eꞌu imoi auga papiau maꞌoai akelogo,” eoma.
Ega aisama Saimon Peto keoma auga isa epaꞌani penia einaka, “Lopia, oi ala alolao?” eoma. Ke Iesu einaka, “Lau ala alalao auga pau muniuai afololao kai, muniai kai alomai,” eoma.
Ke Peto Iesu epaꞌani penia pugu einaka, “Lopia, kapa puo pau munimuai afalafai? Lau ifou lalogoainiau oi faumuai alamae,” eoma.
Ega aisama Iesu einaka, “Koꞌa oi lau puouai alomae ma? Iifa gome maamuai laifania. Oꞌolo aeagaga koa kai oi lau alopuniaiainiau oiso alopamia,” eoma.
